description: Your own product's Google Analytics (GA4) sync, as of its last sync into nooticr — not a live GA4 call: the property, the date range synced and how many daily rows came in. The metrics themselves (installs, opens, purchases, revenue) feed get_post_performance and growth_brief rather than being repeated here. Returns a message rather than an error when nothing has ever been synced; connect GA4 in API Connections first. Takes appId (optional when your workspace has only one product). No cost to call. Use to check whether GA4 data is synced and for which dates.

appId.description: Your product's id. Omit only with a single-app workspace.

name: get_google_analytics_data

message.description: Set instead of data when nothing has been synced yet.

synced_at.description: When nooticr last synced this. Not live: say this date when quoting it.

title: Read Google Analytics Data
